title: 第19章 了解季风第20章 组建军队
content_zh:
“吉恩爵士季风镇属于希望之城派驻的守卫有一百三十人，分三班轮流守卫季风镇，我们也是上任领主遇刺后才派驻到季风镇的，按照规定等领主大人你接收了季风镇我们就得撤了～”
布朗宁直接说道。
“那布朗宁大队长，请问如果我要招收守卫那需要在哪里招收季风镇这里的人合不合适？薪酬多少合适？”
吉恩诚恳的问道。
没办法虽然他有权强行可征用，但是如果能不用也行那就不用，这次跟来酒楼的人只有谭跟他的骑士侍从普艾尼拉，其他人都有自己的事要去做，前面吉恩他们看过了领主府，不大但也不算小，不可能靠着几位战士打扫卫生做饭吧？所以都分队出去采买去了，米莉也跟着出去了（自从上了岸，她就没有回飞船去好好修炼过了，吉恩都被小七吐槽过好几次了，不过吉恩也不好强制让米莉去修炼吧？爱好是最好的老师）。
“领主大人那里可以招人我也没有太好的方向，毕竟我们这些派驻过来的守卫是希望之城那边入伍的，不过薪酬一个月二十～三十银币差不多了，毕竟只是守卫不是士兵，如果是士兵薪酬还要高，不过守卫只会帮助领主守卫城镇，巡视城镇的，如果需要战斗他们可以拒绝的，不过季风镇有很多剩余人口，就是没有种地的能力也没有谋生的能力，只能在镇上码头或者有活干活没活闲逛而且还会偷鸡摸狗～领主大人如果有想法可以把他们召集起来，还可以解决季风镇的部分治安问题”
布朗宁想了想缓缓说道，他也没有说错毕竟他也只是个守卫，也没有正真管理过领地，所以只能给出自己的意见。
“那领地有哪些收入？”
吉恩又问道，不管是干嘛总是要花钱。
“这个我就更快不清楚了，不过领主大人这次可以安排人去收一次税金，按照规定我们守卫从上任领主遇刺后入驻季风镇希望之城政府也没有派人过来征收过税金”
布朗宁说道。
“那上任领主的其他行政人员呢？”
吉恩心想真是操蛋总不可能自己去算账吧？如果什么事都亲力亲为那什么事都做不了，毕竟一个人的精力是有限的，你无法用有限的精力去做无限的事，超人也不行～
“这个我就不清楚了，可能也被害了，反正我们接到消息赶过来路上都花了十多天，等到了季风镇政公署领主府也没见到一个人，还是我们花钱请人搞的卫生～”
布朗宁表示自己也很无奈。
“那事后你们没有调查过政公署及领主府的人员失踪问题吗？还有布朗宁大队长你说如果我想雇佣你们这一大队守卫帮我守卫季风镇半年需要多少钱？”
吉恩一时半会实在是想不到解决办法，就问道。
“第一个问题我们也想找，可惜季风镇的领民都不太愿意配合我们的工作，调查根本无法正常开展，而我们也不是领地的常驻守卫，所以也没有追查到底，第二个，如果是当地领主雇佣我们希望之城的守卫队，这个算是外地出差，正常一个月五十银币应该就行了。”
布朗宁想了想回道。
“可以，那就先这样说，需要我做些什么吗？除了薪酬？”

吉恩问道，心想总算是解决了一件事。
“需要领主大人写一封信交给希望之城贵族理事会（也可以叫贵族管理中心，以后统称贵族理事会），说出您的请求，并写上与我的交易，我也需要在上面签字，不出意外应该没有问题的，季风镇虽然是吉恩爵士的领地，但是它同时也是格林帝国的领地，再结合您现在的家族势力，贵族理事会不出意外肯定会同意吉恩爵士您的请求。”
布朗宁道。
“好，那一会我回去后就写信过来，然后这季风镇有什么私人势力吗？毕竟这是失去领主管理一年多了。”
吉恩又问道。
“有的，有一个接码头搬运工作的搬运协会，还有两个混混帮派，不过因为没有闹出人命，我们之前也只是临时守卫，不是领主没有执法权，所以没办法处理他们，最多在他们斗殴的时候，将他们驱散，吉恩爵士你就有权利处理他们，其它的应该没有了。”
content_en:
"Sir Jean, there are 130 guards stationed in Monsoon Town belonging to the City of Hope. They are divided into three shifts to guard Monsoon Town. We were also stationed in Monsoon Town after the previous lord was assassinated. According to the regulations, we will have to withdraw when you, Lord Lord, take over Monsoon Town~"
Browning said directly.
"Captain Browning, if I want to recruit guards, where should I recruit people from Monsoon Town? What is the appropriate salary?"
Jean asked sincerely.
There is no way, although he has the right to requisition it by force, but if you can do it without it, then don't do it. The only people who came to the restaurant this time were Tan and his knight squire Puianila. Everyone else had their own things to do. Jean and the others had seen the lord's mansion earlier. It was not big but not too small. It was impossible to rely on a few soldiers to clean and cook, right? So they all split up and went out to buy, and Milly followed her out (since landing, she has not returned to the spaceship to practice properly. Jean has been complained about by Xiaoqi several times, but Jean can't force Milly to practice, right? Hobbies are the best teachers).
"I don't have a good direction where the lord can recruit people. After all, the guards we sent here are from the City of Hope, but the salary is about 20 to 30 silver coins a month. After all, they are just guards, not soldiers. If they are soldiers, the salary will be higher, but the guards will only help the lord to guard the town and patrol the town. , they can refuse if they need to fight, but there are many remaining people in Monsoon Town who have no ability to farm or make a living. They can only hang out at the docks in the town or work but not work, and they can also steal and steal. If the lord has ideas, he can call them together and solve some of the security problems in Monsoon Town."
Browning thought for a while and said slowly. He was not wrong. After all, he was just a guard and had never really managed the territory, so he could only give his own opinions.
"What kind of income does the territory have?"
Gene asked again, no matter what you do, you always have to spend money.
"I don't know much about this, but the lord can arrange for someone to collect taxes this time. According to regulations, our guards have not sent anyone to collect taxes since the previous lord was assassinated and the City of Hope government settled in Monsoon Town."
Browning said.
“What about the other administrators of the previous lordship?”
Gene thought to himself that there was no way in hell he could settle the accounts by himself, right? If you do everything yourself, you won't get anything done. After all, a person's energy is limited. You can't use limited energy to do unlimited things, and neither can Superman~
"I don't know about this. He might have been killed. Anyway, we spent more than ten days on the road after receiving the news. When we arrived at the Lord's Mansion of Monsoon Town Government Office, we didn't see anyone. It was because we paid people to do the cleaning~"
Browning said he was also helpless.
"Didn't you investigate the missing persons in the Government Office and the Lord's Mansion after that? And Captain Browning, how much would it cost if I wanted to hire your team of guards to help me guard Monsoon Town for half a year?"
Gene couldn't think of a solution for a while, so he asked.
"We also want to find out the first question, but unfortunately the citizens of Monsoon Town are not willing to cooperate with our work. The investigation cannot be carried out normally at all, and we are not the permanent guards of the territory, so we have not pursued it to the end. Second, if the local lord hires our City of Hope guard team, this is considered a business trip. Normally fifty silver coins a month should be enough."
Browning thought for a moment and replied.
"Okay, let's put it this way first, is there anything you need me to do? Apart from salary?"
Jean asked, thinking that he had finally solved one thing.
"The lord needs to write a letter to the City of Hope Noble Council (which can also be called the Noble Management Center, and henceforth collectively referred to as the Noble Council) stating your request.And write down the transaction with me. I also need to sign it. If nothing happens, there should be no problem. Although Monsoon Town is the territory of Sir Jean, it is also the territory of the Green Empire. Combined with your current family power, the Noble Council will definitely agree to your request, Sir Jean. "
Browning said.
"Okay, I'll write you a letter when I get back. Is there any private power in Monsoon Town? After all, it has been more than a year since the Lord lost his management. "
Gene asked again.
"Yes, there is a porter's association that takes over the port portage work, and there are two gangsters. However, because no one was killed, we were just temporary guards before. It's not that the lord has no law enforcement rights, so there is no way to deal with them. At most, when they fight, disperse them. Sir Jean, you have the right to deal with them, and there should be no others. "
